edits.insertLineAfter: let cmd = if args.len > 0: args[0] else: "list"

edits.newText:
proc formatCsv*(tasks: openArray[Task]): string =
  var lines: seq[string] = @[]
  for t in tasks:
    let title = if contains(t.title, '"'): "\"" & t.title.replace("\"", "\"\"") & '\"' else: t.title
    lines.add($t.id & ", " & title)
  lines.join("\n")
